initiatives.name: Bay Area for Palestine
initiatives.description: Follow for action alerts, info, and safety tips. #PalestineWillBeFree

initiatives.name: Arab Resource & Organizing Center (AROC)
initiatives.description: Provides legal, language-access, and case management services to low-income Arab and Muslim immigrants in the SF Bay Area, and organizes campaigns including for Palestine.

initiatives.name: Queers Undermining Israeli Terrorism (QUIT!)
initiatives.description: Bay Area queer group, founded in 2001, that organizes pickets, boycott (BDS) actions and protests against Israeli pinkwashing in support of Palestinian liberation.

initiatives.name: Bay Area PYM
initiatives.description: Bay Area chapter of the @palestinianyouthmovement

initiatives.name: Bay Area United Against War (BAUAW)
initiatives.description: San Francisco-based anti-war newsletter and coalition covering dockworker actions against weapons shipments, drone warfare, and campaigns for political prisoners.

initiatives.name: Native American Health Center
initiatives.description: Federally qualified community health center serving Native Americans, with medical, dental, behavioral health and WIC services at clinics in San Francisco and Oakland since 1972.

initiatives.name: Sogorea Te Land Trust
initiatives.description: Urban Indigenous women-led land trust in the East Bay that returns land to Indigenous people, runs the voluntary Shuumi Land Tax, and manages sacred sites.

initiatives.name: Idle No More SF Bay
initiatives.description: Indigenous women-led volunteer group, founded in 2013, that organizes healing walks, marches and actions against the Bay Area's oil refineries, especially in the Richmond-to-Rodeo refinery corridor.

initiatives.name: Indigenous Anarchist Federation
initiatives.description: Online platform sharing Indigenous anarchist ideas and struggles across the Americas, active on Bluesky.

initiatives.name: Asian Pacific Environmental Network (APEN)
initiatives.description: Oakland-based environmental justice group organizing Asian immigrant and refugee communities in Oakland Chinatown, Richmond and Carson against polluters.

initiatives.name: Urban Habitat
initiatives.description: Oakland nonprofit that trains low-income residents and residents of color for Bay Area boards and commissions, and does research and advocacy on transportation, housing, land use and climate policy.

initiatives.name: 1000 Grandmothers for Future Generations
initiatives.description: Group of elder women and allies in the Bay Area, based in Berkeley, doing nonviolent climate justice actions and supporting Indigenous and frontline communities.

initiatives.name: 350 Bay Area
initiatives.description: Regional grassroots climate group in the Bay Area, headquartered in Oakland, with local chapters in Marin, Sonoma, Napa, San Francisco, Contra Costa and the East Bay.

initiatives.name: Homecooked Care for Liberation
initiatives.description: Bay Area group that provides homemade meals to people organizing for Palestinian liberation.

initiatives.name: Common Humanity Collective
initiatives.description: Bay Area mutual aid group that builds DIY air purifiers and distributes them free, along with masks and other supplies, through volunteer community builds.

initiatives.name: Bay Area Anarchist Coffeehouse
initiatives.description: Bay Area group that hosts open-mic style potlucks bringing together anarchists and collectives from around the region.

initiatives.name: Bay Area Tenant and Neighborhood Councils
initiatives.description: Member-run tenant union with locals in Oakland, Berkeley, San Francisco and the South Bay, organizing renters and unhoused people against evictions, rent hikes and bad conditions.

initiatives.name: Bay Resistance
initiatives.description: Network of Bay Area community groups, unions and neighborhood groups. Sends rapid response alerts on immigration raids and other threats, runs neighborhood pods, trainings and street campaigns.

initiatives.name: San Francisco Bay View National Black Newspaper
initiatives.description: Independent Black newspaper founded in 1976, serving thought-provoking stories and commentary on the full range of Black trials and triumphs, with a focus on prison abolition, mutual aid, and community empowerment through grassroots journalism.

initiatives.name: Indybay - SF Bay Area Independent Media Center
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run open-publishing news site where people post reports, photos, video and event listings about protests, labor, housing and other social movements in the Bay Area.

initiatives.name: Free Speech TV
initiatives.description: National nonprofit progressive news and opinion TV network covering social, economic and environmental justice. Based in Colorado; broadcasts nationally and streams online.

initiatives.name: CrimethInc.
initiatives.description: Anarchist collective and publisher producing articles, books, zines, posters and podcasts on anti-authoritarian organizing. Operates as a decentralized network, not a local group.

initiatives.name: AK Press
initiatives.description: Worker-run collective that publishes and distributes anarchist and radical-left books, based in Chico, California.

initiatives.name: Mujeres Unidas y Activas (MUA)
initiatives.description: Organization of Latina and Indigenous immigrant women in San Francisco, Oakland and Union City offering workshops, counseling and support, and campaigning for immigrant and domestic worker rights.

initiatives.name: Filipino Advocates for Justice
initiatives.description: Filipino community organization in the East Bay, founded 1973. Runs youth programs, immigration services, worker rights support and civic engagement from offices in Oakland and Union City.

initiatives.name: Bay Area Workers Support (BAWS)
initiatives.description: Sex worker-led group in the Bay Area offering mutual aid grants, a bad date list, resource guides, and community events like an annual resource fair in Oakland.

initiatives.name: Alliance of South Asians Taking Action (ASATA)
initiatives.description: The Alliance of South Asians Taking Action empowers South Asians to end violence, oppression, and exploitation within and against our communities.

initiatives.name: SURJ Bay Area
initiatives.description: Bay Area chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice, organizing white people around racial justice. Current campaigns cover Oakland budget and community safety funding, and Palestine solidarity.

initiatives.name: Anti-Repression Bay Area
initiatives.description: Providing protest support and bail funds for demonstrators through mutual aid networks.

initiatives.name: Community Works West
initiatives.description: Transforming justice through restorative practices, reentry support, and youth empowerment programs across the Bay Area, with a focus on healing and community-led solutions to incarceration.

initiatives.name: Flying Over Walls
initiatives.description: San Francisco-based queer and trans prisoner solidarity project that matches outside pen pals with incarcerated LGBTQ+ people and supports ongoing letter-writing.

initiatives.name: Prison Literature Project
initiatives.description: By sending free reading materials to those behind bars, PLP aims to foster learning and critical thinking and help prepare people to lead successful lives after incarceration.

initiatives.name: Seeing Red Events
initiatives.description: A communist lecture and party series in the Bay Area.

initiatives.name: Lavender Phoenix
initiatives.description: Bay Area organization (formerly APIENC) of transgender, non-binary, and queer Asian and Pacific Islander people that trains grassroots leaders and runs member organizing programs.

initiatives.name: Bay Area Transformative Justice Collective
initiatives.description: Oakland-based collective that runs trainings and support for transformative justice responses to harm, especially child sexual abuse.
